sn35.31:1.3: Katamā ca sā bhikkhave sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā || || 4-6
sn35.31:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhuṃ na maññati cakkhusmiṃ na maññati cakkhuto na maññati Cakkhu me ti na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na maññati || || cakkhusamphassaṃ na maññati || || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi na maññati Tam me ti na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.7: Yaṃ hi bhikkhave maññati yasmiṃ maññati yato maññati yam Me ti maññati || tato taṃ hoti aññathā ||
sn35.31:1.8: aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavam evābhinandati || || pe || || 7-8
sn35.31:1.9: Jivhaṃ na maññati jivhāya na maññati jivhāto na maññati Jivhā me ti na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.11: jivhāviññāṇam na maññati || jivhāsamphassaṃ na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.12: Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi na maññati tasmim pi na maññati tato pi na maññati Tam me ti na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.13: Yaṃ hi bhikkhave maññati yasmiṃ maññati yato maññati yam Me ti maññati || tato taṃ hoti aññathā ||
sn35.31:1.14: aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavam evābhinandati || || pe || || 9
sn35.31:1.15: Manaṃ na maññati manasmiṃ na maññati manato na maññati Mano me ti na maññati ||
sn35.31:1.18: Yam pidam -Tam me ti na maññati || ||
sn35.31:1.19: Yaṃ hi bhikkhave maññati || yasmim maññati || yato maññati || yam Me ti maññati || tato taṃ hoti aññathā ||
sn35.31:1.21: Yāvatā bhikkhave khandhadhātu āyatanaṃ tam pi na maññati tasmim pi na maññati tato pi na maññati Tam me ti na maññati ||
sn35.31:1.22: so evaṃ na maññamāno na kiñci loke upādiyati
sn35.31:1.23: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati || ||
sn35.31:1.24: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || 11
sn35.31:1.25: Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā
